name: quench
description: See where your Claude Code and Codex spend goes, ranked by what you could change, with an optional guard that holds the first prompt after a long break.

break_guard.title: Break guard
break_guard.description: Off by default. When on, after a break of over an hour the first prompt to a large session is held once with what sending it will cost; send it again to go ahead, or /clear for new work.

guard_min_context.title: Break guard: smallest context
guard_min_context.description: The guard never holds a session smaller than this many tokens of context.
